images.title: Hop along the multiples of 30
images.purpose: Show that numbers divisible by 5 and 6 are the multiples of 30, and that checking each one for the remainder on division by 7 finds 60.
images.composition: One number line across the middle with two hops, a short remainder card under each landing point, and a heading above, wide margins.
exact_structure: Heading above: Multiples of the LCM, 30.
A grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 60 with ticks labelled 0, 30 and 60 only.
Exactly 2 teal #0072B2 hop arcs: 0 to 30 and 30 to 60.
Under 30: a grey card 30 = 7 × 4 + 2, remainder 2 written beneath, with a small grey cross.
Under 60: a green #009E73 card 60 = 7 × 8 + 4, remainder 4 written beneath, with a green tick, and a reddish purple #CC79A7 ring around 60 on the line.
rejection: hops of a size other than 30, or more or fewer than 2 hops
remainders other than 2 for 30 and 4 for 60
images.takeaway: List the multiples of the LCM and test each one until the remainder fits.
images.description: A number line hopping 0, 30, 60, with 30 = 7 × 4 + 2 crossed out and 60 = 7 × 8 + 4 ticked and ringed.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video on remainders and catching up.
images.teaching_notes: Read the two cards in order; the first multiple whose remainder matches is the answer.

image_decisions.why: Hops along the multiples make the test and check search visible at a glance.
